<description>
When a transaction spends outputs owned by the wallet, the wallet invalidates
the cached amounts of the transactions those outputs came from, and
`CommitTransaction` also notifies them. Neither is needed.

Both date back to pre-#27286, when a `CWalletTx` also cached the available
amount. Now the balance is read live from `m_txos` and `mapTxSpends`, and
`CWalletTx` cache only its own, tx specific, incoming and outgoing amounts,
and whether the tx is from the wallet. None of this changes after one of its
outputs is spent. So the cache invalidation recomputes the same values, and
the notification makes the GUI refresh a status that has not changed.
</description>

[2026-07-24] r:4775356469 review COMMENTED by pablomartin4btc (member):
Concept ACK

Checked https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/27286.

After the above PR, the per-transaction caches (`m_amounts`, `m_cached_from_me`) reflect the transaction's own incoming/outgoing amounts — none of these change when a child tx spends one of the parent's outputs. So `MarkInputsDirty` is forcing a recompute that produces the same result, and the `CommitTransaction` notification loop is asking the GUI to repaint a row that looks identical. Both are dead work; removing them is correct.

Left some comments and nits (none blocking).

[2026-07-29] c:5122543745 comment by Bicaru20 (contributor):
ACK 0ec1a08131.

I agree `MarkInputsDirty` is no longer needed. As explained in the description, since https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/27286 `CWalletTx` no longer saves on cache the amount aviable to spend since this was moved to `m_txos` and `mapTxSpends`. Now, the `CWalletTx` it only save the `m_amounts` which saves the fixed incoming and outgoing amounts, and the `m_cached_from_me` which saves whether the tx originated from the wallet.

In bdf7c84eda, the tests checks, through various paths, that the cached values are not changed. The first test checks the `CommitTransaction`  and `AddToWallet` path by commiting a transaction that spends from a coin owned by the wallet, and the `RecursiveUpdateTxState` path by using `AbandonTransaction` on a spending transaction. The other test, chechs the `SyncTransaction` path by using `transactionAddedToMempool` with a spending transaction.

[2026-09-15] c:5672587254 comment by w0xlt (contributor):
This invalidation is still needed in a narrow case. A transaction pays 1 BTC to each of two wallet addresses, but the wallet hasn’t derived one address yet, so it recognizes and caches only 1 BTC.

A later spend can expand the keypool and make the wallet recognize the second payment. Without this invalidation, `gettransaction` still reports 1 BTC, even though details shows both payments.

The test below passes on master (51ddab532c) and fails on 4591142a8f: the parent’s amount remains 1 BTC when 2 BTC is expected.

It’s a very narrow edge case, but it may still be worth addressing.

diff --git a/test/functional/wallet_keypool_topup.py b/test/functional/wallet_keypool_topup.py
index aae6985f5b..a8277bb231 100755
--- a/test/functional/wallet_keypool_topup.py
+++ b/test/functional/wallet_keypool_topup.py
@@ -11,8 +11,11 @@ Two nodes. Node1 is under test. Node0 is providing transactions and generating b
 - Stop node1, clear the datadir, move wallet file back into the datadir and restart node1.
 - connect node1 to node0. Verify that they sync and node1 receives its funds."""
 import shutil
+from decimal import Decimal

 from test_framework.blocktools import COINBASE_MATURITY
+from test_framework.descriptors import descsum_create
+from test_framework.extendedkey import ExtendedPrivateKey
 from test_framework.test_framework import BitcoinTestFramework
 from test_framework.util import (
     assert_equal,
@@ -88,6 +91,64 @@ class KeypoolRestoreTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
             elif output_type == 'bech32m':
                 assert_equal(self.nodes[idx].getaddressinfo(self.nodes[idx].getnewaddress(address_type=output_type))['hdkeypath'], "m/86h/1h/0h/0/110")

+        self.test_cached_parent_credit()
+
+    def test_cached_parent_credit(self):
+        self.log.info("Test parent credit is refreshed when a spend expands the keypool")
+        self.restart_node(1, extra_args=['-keypool=1'])
+        self.connect_nodes(0, 1)
+        self.sync_all()
+
+        for delivery in ("mempool", "block"):
+            self.log.info(f"Test keypool expansion via a {delivery} notification")
+            wallet_name = f"cached_credit_{delivery}"
+            self.nodes[1].createwallet(wallet_name, blank=True)
+            wallet = self.nodes[1].get_wallet_rpc(wallet_name)
+            desc = descsum_create(f"wpkh({ExtendedPrivateKey.generate().to_string()}/*)")
+            assert_equal(wallet.importdescriptors([{
+                "desc": desc,
+                "timestamp": "now",
+                "range": [0, 0],
+                "active": True,
+            }]), [{"success": True}])
+            addresses = self.nodes[0].deriveaddresses(desc, [0, 2])
+
+            # Index 2 is outside the keypool even after receiving at index 0
+            # extends it to index 1. Keep these outputs in this order.
+            raw_parent = self.nodes[0].createrawtransaction([], [{addresses[2]: 1}, {addresses[0]: 1}])
+            funded_parent = self.nodes[0].fundrawtransaction(raw_parent, {"changePosition": 2})
+            signed_parent = self.nodes[0].signrawtransactionwithwallet(funded_parent["hex"])
+            parent_txid = self.nodes[0].sendrawtransaction(signed_parent["hex"])
+            self.generate(self.nodes[0], 1)
+
+            # Populate the parent's credit cache before index 2 becomes owned.
+            parent = wallet.gettransaction(parent_txid)
+            assert_equal(parent["amount"], 1)
+            assert_equal(len(parent["details"]), 1)
+            assert_equal(wallet.getaddressinfo(addresses[2])["ismine"], False)
+
+            raw_spend = self.nodes[0].createrawtransaction(
+                [{"txid": parent_txid, "vout": 1}], [{addresses[1]: Decimal("0.9999")}])
+            signed_spend = wallet.signrawtransactionwithwallet(raw_spend)
+            assert_equal(signed_spend["complete"], True)
+            if delivery == "block":
+                self.disconnect_nodes(0, 1)
+                assert_equal(self.nodes[1].getconnectioncount(), 0)
+            self.nodes[0].sendrawtransaction(signed_spend["hex"])
+            if delivery == "block":
+                self.generate(self.nodes[0], 1, sync_fun=self.no_op)
+                self.connect_nodes(0, 1)
+                self.sync_all()
+            else:
+                self.sync_mempools()
+
+            # Processing the spend at index 1 extends the keypool to index 2,
+            # making the parent's other output ours without a descriptor import.
+            assert_equal(wallet.getaddressinfo(addresses[2])["ismine"], True)
+            parent = wallet.gettransaction(parent_txid)
+            assert_equal(len(parent["details"]), 2)
+            assert_equal(parent["amount"], 2)
+

 if __name__ == '__main__':
     KeypoolRestoreTest(__file__).main()
